## Exercise Goals

- Increase topic mastery.
- Construct knowledge.
- Give you data to evaluate how well you are learning.

<!-- Slide 76 -->

---

## Programming Exercise

Create a <code>Point2D</code> class that represents a point in a two-dimensional plane with <code>x</code> and <code>y</code> coordinates.

- Overload <code>&lt;&lt;</code> to display the point as <code>(x, y)</code>.
- Overload <code>&gt;&gt;</code> to read the point's coordinates.
- Implement both overloaded operators as friend functions.
